text: Review docs/design/defaults-loop.md, written to docs/design/reviews/defaults-loop-review-1.md, ending with a verdict (accept, accept with changes listed, or reject). Check its evidence against the records it cites and its claims against the code. Also check it against how Jev is actually reached, which I probed today through the gateway: /v1/chat/completions refuses Jev ('a decision model, not a language model'); Jev is called with POST https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1/evaluate, body {model: 'typesafe-ai/jev', state: <text>, questions: {<key>: {type: 'boolean' or 'choice', instructions, criteria: {<option>: <description>}}}}; the answer gives choice, per-option probabilities and a confidence; an optional fallback model can run when confidence is below a threshold (providerOptions.gateway.models with when.confidenceBelow). One probe: the correction 'A CHANGELOG.md entry in the repository's usual style is allowed alongside the design doc', asked against changelog, small, root-cause, designed and none, returned changelog at 0.90 (none 0.06, designed 0.04), confidence 0.87, 409 input and 59 output tokens, cost /bin/bash.000017. Review only.
